state.event: The reply arrived Wednesday March 11, 2026 at 13:30 New York local time.
state.rules: A support window is measured in New York local time. It opens at 09:00 on the first business day after a notice is received and lasts exactly 52 hours of elapsed time. Business days only determine opening; after opening, weekends do not pause it. Notice was received Friday March 6, 2026 at 18:10 New York time. Saturday and Sunday are nonbusiness days. In 2026 New York daylight saving time begins Sunday March 8 at 02:00, when clocks jump to 03:00. There are no holidays.

decision.instructions: Apply all stated timing, unit, inclusion, correction, and threshold rules; select the exact band.

criteria.before_open: The event occurred before the window opened.
criteria.late_by_2h_or_more: The event was at least two hours late.
criteria.late_by_under_2h: The event occurred after closing but less than two hours late.
criteria.within_window: The event occurred from opening through the exact closing instant.
